title: Production on a phone: one column and the total up front
description: The production builder and its payment step on phones (390x844, 360x740, 844x390, desktop-site) in one scrolling column of 44 px rows, and the total cost of everything staged shown on the first dialog (sticky footer: total, builds, per-build costs, cost reduction, availability, 'Build (N)') and repeated on the payment panel. Before shots from the commit before the change. Synthetic fixtures through a mocked server.

shots.heading: Before: builder with 2 cruisers + carrier staged, phone 390x844
shots.caption: Unit cards in two columns on wide phone layouts; no total, 'Confirm builds'.

shots.heading: After: builder with 2 cruisers + carrier staged, phone 390x844
shots.caption: One column on phones; sticky footer shows 'Total: 7 resources — 3 builds', per-build costs, 'You have 9 available · 2 left' and 'Build (7)'.
